title: ABOUT ML: Annotation and Benchmarking on Understanding and Transparency of Machine Learning Lifecycles
reasoning: The paper's entire focus is on operationalizing the ethical principle of transparency in machine learning systems. It introduces the 'ABOUT ML' project, an initiative designed to translate ethical ideals into practical, standardized documentation practices to improve fairness, accountability, and trustworthiness. This is a core treatment of applied ethics, not a peripheral section.
